description: Full inventory of every API endpoint, grouped by which panel/app consumes it. 'status' marks whether the endpoint existed before this update, is brand new, or had its behavior changed.

statusLegend.existing: Was already working before this update — unchanged
statusLegend.new: Did not exist before this update
statusLegend.updated: Existed before, but its behavior changed in this update

sharedAndAuth.description: Health check and login/OTP endpoints used by both the User app and the Service Provider app.

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: Liveness check, returns {status:'ok'}.

endpoints.name: Check Mobile Before OTP
endpoints.description: Body: {phone, role}. Tells the client if this number is already registered, before the OTP is even sent. Never creates anything.

endpoints.name: Send OTP
endpoints.description: Body: {phone, role}. Generates and stores a one-time code. No SMS gateway is configured yet, so outside production the response also includes {devOtp} (and logs it) so the flow is testable end-to-end. Replaces the old Firebase phone-auth requirement entirely.

endpoints.name: Verify OTP (Login/Register)
endpoints.description: Body: {phone, role, otp, name?}. Verifies the code from Send OTP, then finds-or-creates the User/ServiceProvider and returns a JWT. Used to always require a Firebase idToken and would 500 in production because Firebase Admin was never configured — that dependency is now removed.

endpoints.name: Admin Login
endpoints.description: Body: {email, password}. Email/password login for the seeded admin account, returns a JWT.

userPanel.description: Endpoints consumed by the customer-facing (User) app.

endpoints.name: Get My Profile
endpoints.description: Returns the logged-in user's full profile document.

endpoints.name: Update My Profile
endpoints.description: Body: {name?, email?, gender?, dob?, city?, state?, pincode?, profileImage?}. Used for both edit-profile and first-time profile completion.

endpoints.name: Update My Address/Location
endpoints.description: Body: {text, lat?, lng?}. lat/lng are now optional — the mobile app has no GPS, so most calls only ever send text. If either coordinate is provided, both must be valid.

endpoints.name: Get Saved Addresses
endpoints.description: Returns the plain string[] list shown in the address picker.

endpoints.name: Add Saved Address
endpoints.description: Body: {address}. Idempotent — adding the same text twice is a no-op.

endpoints.name: Delete Saved Address
endpoints.description: Body: {address}. Matches by exact text.

endpoints.name: List Categories
endpoints.description: Active categories only, each with its subServices array — the "what service do you need" list.

endpoints.name: Search Providers
endpoints.description: Query: categoryId?, lat?, lng?, radiusKm?. Only approved+available providers. When lat/lng are passed, each result now includes a computed distanceKm (Haversine) — this field did not exist before.

endpoints.name: Get Provider Profile
endpoints.description: Full public profile for one provider, shown on the provider profile screen.

endpoints.name: Get Provider Reviews
endpoints.description: Reviews left for this provider, newest first — did not exist before.

endpoints.name: Create Booking
endpoints.description: Body: {providerId, categoryId, subServiceId?, scheduledAt, timeSlot?, address?, notes?, couponCode?}. Applies SGSAVE30/FIRST99/CLEANPRO coupon logic and computes discount/tax/finalAmount server-side.

endpoints.name: My Booking History
endpoints.description: All of the logged-in user's bookings, newest first.

endpoints.name: Track Booking
endpoints.description: Single booking detail — also usable by the assigned provider.

endpoints.name: Cancel Booking
endpoints.description: Only valid while status is pending/broadcasted/accepted.

endpoints.name: Rate & Review
endpoints.description: Body: {rating, comment?}. Only valid once the booking is completed/paid; updates the provider's rating average.

endpoints.name: Create Razorpay Order
endpoints.description: Body: {bookingId}. Requires RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET to be configured — returns 503 until they are.

endpoints.name: Verify Razorpay Payment
endpoints.description: Body: {razorpayOrderId, razorpayPaymentId, razorpaySignature} from the Razorpay Checkout callback.

endpoints.name: Get Chat Messages
endpoints.description: Full message history for a booking.

endpoints.name: Send Chat Message
endpoints.description: Body: {text, imageUrl?}. Also broadcast live over Socket.io to room booking:<id> as event 'message'.

endpoints.name: Get My Notifications
endpoints.description: Newest first. Also pushed live over Socket.io to room account:<userId> as event 'notification' — that socket push is new (see realtime section).

endpoints.name: Clear All Notifications
endpoints.description: Deletes every notification for this user.

endpoints.name: File Complaint
endpoints.description: Body: {bookingId?, subject, description}.

serviceProviderPanel.description: Endpoints consumed by the Service Provider app.

endpoints.name: Update My Provider Profile
endpoints.description: Body: {name?, email?, profileImage?, categories?, documents?, bio?, skills?, languages?, experienceYears?, baseHourlyRate?, address?}. categories must be valid, active Category ids.

endpoints.name: Update My Location
endpoints.description: Body: {text, lat, lng} — lat/lng still required here (drives the geo-search $near query), unlike the User panel's version of this endpoint.

endpoints.name: Update Availability
endpoints.description: Body: {isAvailable}.

endpoints.name: My Bookings (Order Receive)
endpoints.description: Query: status? (optional filter).

endpoints.name: Update Booking Status
endpoints.description: Body: {status, price?}. Valid transitions: accepted/rejected/on-the-way/reached/started/completed. Now also pushes the update live over Socket.io to room booking:<id> as event 'booking-status', and pushes the resulting notification to room account:<userId> as event 'notification' — both socket pushes are new.

endpoints.name: Mark Cash Payment Received
endpoints.description: Body: {bookingId}. Booking must be status 'completed' first; splits the price into commission + payout and credits provider earnings.

endpoints.name: Get Chat Messages (Provider side)
endpoints.description: Same endpoint as User Panel.

endpoints.name: Send Chat Message (Provider side)
endpoints.description: Same endpoint as User Panel.

adminPanel.description: Endpoints consumed by the internal Admin panel.

endpoints.name: Update My Admin Profile
endpoints.description: Body: {name?}.

endpoints.name: Change My Password
endpoints.description: Body: {currentPassword, newPassword}.

endpoints.name: Create Category
endpoints.description: Body: {name, icon?, description?, commissionPercent?}.

endpoints.name: Update Category / Set Commission
endpoints.description: Body: {name?, icon?, description?, isActive?, commissionPercent?}.

endpoints.name: Deactivate Category
endpoints.description: Hides it from the public list without deleting it.

endpoints.name: Delete Category
endpoints.description: Hard-deletes only if no provider/booking references it — otherwise 409, deactivate instead.

endpoints.name: Add Sub-Service
endpoints.description: Body: {name, description?, basePrice}.

endpoints.name: Update Sub-Service
endpoints.description: Body: any of {name?, description?, basePrice?}.

endpoints.name: List Providers (Approval Queue)
endpoints.description: Query: approved? (true/false to filter, omit for all).

endpoints.name: Approve Provider
endpoints.description: Required before any user can search for or book this provider.

endpoints.name: List Complaints
endpoints.description: Query: status? (open/in-progress/resolved/rejected).

endpoints.name: Resolve Complaint
endpoints.description: Body: {status, adminNote?}.

endpoints.name: Payment Reports
endpoints.description: Query: status?, from?, to?.

endpoints.name: Analytics Dashboard
endpoints.description: Users/providers counts, bookings by status, top categories, revenue and commission totals.

realtime.description: Socket.io events. Connect to the server root (not the /api prefix) with auth: {token: <jwt>}.

clientEmits.description: Joins room booking:<id> — only succeeds if the connected account owns or is assigned to that booking.

serverEmits.description: A new chat message, same shape as GET /api/chat/:bookingId items.
The full updated booking document, fired whenever a provider changes its status.
A new notification document, fired whenever one is created (currently: booking status changes). Every authenticated socket auto-joins its own account:<id> room on connect.
Emitted then the socket is disconnected if the JWT is missing/invalid.
